--asset.help: Release artifact to attach (may be provided more than once)

--baseline.help: Suppress findings listed in a baseline

--dynamic-threshold.help: Min static risk score for dynamic (batch, default: 25)

--no-llm.help: Skip LLM analysis — static patterns only.

--no-require-llm.help: Allow non-English scans without LLM (results will be incomplete).

--target.help: Commit SHA for the release tag

--workers.help: Number of parallel scan workers (default: 4).  Reduce to 1 for free-tier API keys, increase for enterprise tiers.  Skills that time out (90s) are skipped; other workers continue.

input_dir.help: Directory containing skill subdirectories (each with a SKILL.md).
